pass_1.finding: Independently checked Mahat et al. 2016 original PRO-seq Table 1. VRA3 is a 5-prime-phosphorylated 3-prime RNA adapter with /Inverted dT/ at its 3-prime end; VRA5 is unphosphorylated at its 5-prime end; RP1 serves both RT and PCR; RPI-n carries six sample-index Ns. PRO-cap RA3/RA5/RTP are separately listed and must not be substituted for PRO-seq. ChRO JATS says its library preparation closely followed this method but also says some ChRO libraries used six-base molecule UMIs in adapters, so Table 1 cannot establish an unchanged oligo variant for every ChRO library.
